name: Upgrade (personal loans, Upgrade Card)
notes: Researched from public upgrade.com help articles only (no sign-in); modelled as the personal loan. Autopay withdraws the disclosed monthly payment on the due date and must be enrolled or cancelled at least 3 business days before the payment date; cancelling autopay cancels all future payments (online cancel is inferred; pending drafts are cancelled by contacting Upgrade). Scheduled one-time payments can be cancelled online (trash icon) up to 1 business day before. Due date changes are self-service for current personal loans (within 15 days, at least 3 business days before the next due date; not modelled). Short-Term Hardship program by phone at (888) 873-5960, so payment_arrangement is unsupported online. Late fee may apply after 15 days (amount not published). Debit card payments exist (terms page) but no fee is published; methods bank and card (inferred). No prepayment fees. Reviewer 2026-10-10: the sign-in page asks for Email Address and Password on one screen (also offers passkey sign-in). The make-a-payment article lists (855) 598-1271 for phone payments while the pay-by-phone article lists (844) 899-9931; both are shown.

autopay.note: Autopay withdraws your monthly payment on your due date. Enroll at least 3 business days before the payment date.

autopay_cancel.note: Cancel at least 3 business days before the payment date. Cancelling autopay cancels all future payments.

scheduled_payment.note: Scheduled one-time payments can be cancelled up to 1 business day before the payment date.

payment_arrangement.note: Hardship options, such as reduced payments for a set time, are arranged by phone. Call (888) 873-5960.

pay_by_phone.note: Call Account Servicing at (844) 899-9931, Monday-Friday 5AM-7PM PT and weekends 6AM-5PM PT.

help.title: Ways to pay
paragraphs: Set up autopay or make one-time payments from your dashboard, pay by phone at (855) 598-1271 or through Account Servicing at (844) 899-9931, or mail a personal check, cashier's check or money order payable to Upgrade, Inc. with your Account ID in the memo.
Personal loan payments by mail go to Upgrade, Inc., Lbx #452210, P.O. Box 52210, Phoenix, AZ 85072-2210.

help.title: Cancelling a scheduled payment
paragraphs: Sign in, select Payments, find Scheduled Payments and select the trash icon next to the payment. Scheduled one-time payments can be cancelled up to 1 business day before the payment date. To stop a pending autopay draft, contact Upgrade at least 3 business days before it.

help.title: Changing your due date
paragraphs: If your personal loan is current, you can change your due date in your dashboard to a date no more than 15 days before or after the original one. Request it at least 3 business days before your next due date, or it takes effect the following month. Moving the date later can add interest at the end of the loan.

help.title: Late fees
paragraphs: For personal loans, a late fee may apply if your payment is not received within 15 calendar days of the due date. A late fee is charged only once per late payment, and interest keeps accruing daily. There are no prepayment fees.

extra.intent: Using Upgrade's help center, find how many days after the due date a personal loan payment can arrive before a late fee may apply. Do not make a payment.

solution.text: A late fee may apply if the payment is not received within 15 calendar days of the due date.

extra.intent: Using Upgrade's help center, find how many business days before the payment date you must cancel autopay for it to apply to the upcoming payment. Do not change any settings.

solution.text: Enroll in or cancel autopay at least 3 business days before the scheduled payment date.
